Q1
Which area of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. A workflow or automation script — name the workflow/script/path if known (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation or repository configuration — name the file/path if known
C. Another repo area — name the exact file/path or behavior
Q2
What is the concrete problem or improvement you want?
Choices:
A. Something is broken or regressed — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. It works, but it is unreliable, slow, noisy, or hard to operate — describe the pain point
C. It works, but docs/UX/maintainability should be improved — describe what should be clearer or easier
Q3
What should count as “done” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific scenario or trigger produces a specific result — provide that example (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific observable artifact changes — name the workflow output, log, label, comment, or PR behavior that should change
C. Another concrete acceptance criterion — describe it
